decisions.decision: Researched encounters in depth (max hit, instance, teleport) only for quests reachable now or with about one level or boost; skill-blocked quests get an encounter roster only.
decisions.reason: Dispatch asks for complete coverage without trivia; most Agility-XP quests need skills far above the owner's (e.g. Herblore 1, Thieving 24, Crafting 21), so per-NPC detail there would not change any near-term route and can be added later.

Dropping blocked quests entirely (would hide their Agility XP and Defence implications from the planner)

decisions.decision: One claim per quest for the skill-requirement set (value holds each skill's requirement, owner level and boostability) instead of one claim per skill.
decisions.reason: A requirement set is one fact on the quest page, and splitting it would triple the claim count without helping verification.

decisions.decision: Defence-XP claims cite both the quest's reward box and the wiki's complete fixed-Defence-XP table; a separate claim lists all 13 fixed-Defence rewards.
decisions.reason: A zero Defence reward is an absence, and is best shown by the quest's absence from the complete Defence table. The table also lets the XP engine cost prerequisite chains (Dragon Slayer I, Heroes', Nature Spirit, Myreque).
alternatives_considered: Quoting only the quest reward box
